text:
The circuit connecting a room heater to the mains electricity supply has a fuse in it.
The fuse melts and switches off the circuit.
Why does the wire in the fuse melt?
A
The air in the room becomes too damp.
B
The air in the room reaches its required temperature.
C
The insulation around the circuit wire becomes damaged.
D
The current in the circuit becomes too large.

options.label: A
options.text: The air in the room becomes too damp.

options.label: B
options.text: The air in the room reaches its required temperature.

options.label: C
options.text: The insulation around the circuit wire becomes damaged.

options.label: D
options.text: The current in the circuit becomes too large.
